## Strategy

## Gaps
The inspected specialization duplicates the existing \(a=b=2\) case and was mislabeled. Degrees \(11,\ldots,20\) were not enumerated, and no \(U_dM_dV_d=D_d\) witnesses were required. Therefore the requested target is **not established**.
